blurb: This check verifies that when LDAP authentication is required (authtype ldap_auth in /etc/security/ldap/ldap.cfg), SSL is used between LDAP clients and LDAP servers (useSSL yes), protecting the integrity of remote access sessions. It reads /etc/security/ldap/ldap.cfg with two read-only greps; LDAP authentication without useSSL yes is a finding.
